stations.title: Wilma
stations.say: Only the fern book goes up today.
stations.note: Keep the closing note for later.

stations.title: Femi's Monday
stations.text: A new look, a staged note, a staged book.
stations.note: One commit would take two of them.

captions: Wilma wants only Femi's new book on the shop's site today.
Femi also left a new look and a staged closing note, and a commit would take them along.
You throw one change away and take one out of the staging area, in three tasks.
The site keeps its look, gets one new book, and the note waits in the file.
Nothing went into the history that should not.
